age.evidence: GPR143 KO mice generated in C57BL/6J genetic background, and wild-type (WT) littermates (6-12 weeks old, 20-25 g) were used.

sex.evidence: GPR143 KO mice generated in C57BL/6J genetic background, and wild-type (WT) littermates (6-12 weeks old, 20-25 g) were used. (No sex stated.)

dosing.doses_raw: DOI (1 mg/kg) or saline; DOI (1.0 mg/kg, i.p.)
dosing.evidence: The traveled distance (cm) was calculated every 5 min, from 60 min before to 120 min after intraperitoneal (i.p.) administration of DOI (1 mg/kg) or saline.

assays.assay_description: Locomotor activity measured in a 50 × 50 × 40 cm chamber; traveled distance calculated in 5-min bins from 60 min before to 120 min after i.p. DOI (1 mg/kg) or saline in GPR143 KO and WT littermate mice (time course and total reported).

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneal (i.p.) administration of DOI (1 mg/kg) or saline

setup_habituation.evidence: No separate apparatus habituation described; the 60-min pre-injection period was part of the recorded session.

setup_restrain.evidence: Locomotor activity was measured in a chamber (50 × 50 × 40 cm3) — freely moving apparatus.

food_restriction.evidence: Locomotor activity was measured in a chamber (50 × 50 × 40 cm3); no food in apparatus described.

water_restriction.evidence: Locomotor activity was measured in a chamber (50 × 50 × 40 cm3); no water in apparatus described.

time_to_assay.evidence: from 60 min before to 120 min after intraperitoneal (i.p.) administration of DOI (1 mg/kg) or saline

sample_size.evidence: Fig. 1: "in GPR143 KO and WT mice (n = 7-8)"; F(1, 26) error df consistent with 30 animals across 4 groups.

outcomes.summary: DOI (1 mg/kg, i.p.) increased locomotor activity (traveled distance) in both WT and GPR143 KO mice; the hyperlocomotor effect was significantly augmented in GPR143 KO mice compared with WT littermates.
outcomes.evidence: DOI increased the locomotor activity in both genotypes (Fig. 1A and B). The effect of DOI was augmented in GPR143 KO compared to WT mice (genotype: F(1, 26) = 5.43, P = 0.028; drug: F(1, 26) = 3976, P < 0.001; genotype × time: F(1, 26) = 4.76, P = 0.038; Fig. 1B).

B1_num_measures.evidence: The traveled distance (cm) was calculated every 5 min (time course and total of the same variable).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The traveled distance (cm) was calculated every 5 min, from 60 min before to 120 min after ... administration; time course shown in Fig. 1A.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Only traveled distance measured; no transitions or sequences analysed.

B5_social.evidence: Locomotor activity in a chamber; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Locomotor activity is not a learned/cognitive task.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: No behavioural classification software described; traveled distance only.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Data analyzed using two-way ANOVA; no multivariate analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Locomotor activity was measured in a chamber (50 × 50 × 40 cm3)

E7_social_context.evidence: No conspecific described in the locomotor chamber during recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: from 60 min before to 120 min after administration — one continuous recording session

D2_session_duration.evidence: from 60 min before to 120 min after administration (180 min total)

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single 180-min session; no repeated test days described.

D4_baseline.evidence: traveled distance was calculated every 5 min, from 60 min before ... administration

D5_followup.evidence: Recording ended 120 min after DOI; no ≥24 h follow-up.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural assay (locomotor activity); c-Fos IHC, microdialysis and CHO-cell immunoblot/co-IP are non-behavioural and excluded.
B1 set to 0 (modal; qwen and deepseek4): traveled distance time-course and total are the same single measure. gemma4's score of 1 was inconsistent with its own value '1'; behavioural raw_total = 1.
n_total set to 30 based on n = 7-8 across 4 groups and error df F(1,26) (= N − 4); confidence medium.
time_dependent set to n/a since time_to_assay is a single timepoint; the reported 'genotype × time' term appears to refer to the interaction in Fig. 1B.
Sex not stated in paper; strain alone does not imply sex.
